This Kitchen Knife is only present in Freelancer Mode.

However, due to rising interest in said Kitchen Knife by various people (usually because the site mentions on which Level it is on regardless of the Variant chosen and because this leads to the Site marking it on Level 4 yet people don't find it because they are on the wrong Variant), I've taken the liberty to be extra clear that this Kitchen Knife is ONLY IN FREELANCER.

The same thing applies to every Item that is present in Freelancer but not in the Main Mission variant (or vice versa), but due to numerous mentions about this specific one, I would once again iterate that it is IN FREELANCER MODE ONLY.

Basically, it was initially marked on all variants.
This was incorrect, which was mentioned to us and thus we fixed it so it was only visible if you had chosen a Freelancer Mission Variant.
However, because it still shows up in Search and it highlight the Level it is on even when you are in a different variant, this led to people searching for Kitchen Knife, noticing that it was on Level 4 based on the highlight, yet being unable to find said Kitchen Knife because they were in the wrong Variant.
This meant that now instead of people mentioning that it was incorrectly marked on Professional variant, people were mentioning that they couldn't find it on the page, because they were on Professional variant and not the correct Freelancer variants where it resided.
So essentially people were asking about the Kitchen Knife in both cases, though for completely different reasons.

Of course this won't be a problem anymore when we make it so Items looked up in Search won't show up if you are in the wrong variant, but for now I have decided to go with the ultimatum and marked this Kitchen Knife in every variant with the Information that it's ONLY AVAILABLE IN FREELANCER.

If you have any questions or anything else in mind regarding this Kitchen Knife (or something else HITMAN™ related), feel free to take a look at the HITMAPS™ Discord Server.

Thank you for coming to my TED Talk.

-ArstotzkaGreat
